newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns Ba1 to Minebea CBs.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Ba1 to Minebea CBs.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday that it had assigned its Ba1 rating to Minebea Co Ltd's domestic convertible bonds.

The bonds that were assigned a rating were 20 billion yen worth of 0.8 percent domestic convertibles due 2003 and 30 billion yen worth of 0.65 percent convertibles due 2005, Moody's said in a statement.

The rating reflects Minebea's dominant position in its market, its relatively diversified product lines and the management's clear and focused approach toward strengthening the company's competitive edge in the area of high precision parts, Moody's said.

The rating also recognises the company's vulnerability to the demand cycle of its customers' products such as personal computers and PC peripherals, continuous pricing pressure on its electronics device and component products, and its high financial leverage, Moody's said.
This is the first time that Moody's has rated the debt of Minebea.
